section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, portage and withholding
label: Presumption
value: People registered (trade and companies register, crafts register, commercial agents, Urssaf) are presumed not to be employees of their client for that activity (Code du travail L8221-6 I)
note: Tax treaties can reduce or remove the art. 182 B withholding. The wording of the subordination test is the Code du travail numérique's glossary definition.
source_title: Légifrance: Code du travail, article L8221-6 (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2023, modifié par l'ordonnance n° 2021-1189 du 15 septembre 2021, art. 35); Code du travail numérique (ministère du Travail): glossaire, Lien de subordination

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, portage and withholding
label: Official test: lien de subordination
value: A contract of employment exists where the work is done under the authority of an employer who gives instructions, checks their execution and can sanction failures; a registered person working in a permanent legal subordination to the client can be reclassified (L8221-6 II)
note: Tax treaties can reduce or remove the art. 182 B withholding. The wording of the subordination test is the Code du travail numérique's glossary definition.
source_title: Légifrance: Code du travail, article L8221-6 (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2023, modifié par l'ordonnance n° 2021-1189 du 15 septembre 2021, art. 35); Code du travail numérique (ministère du Travail): glossaire, Lien de subordination

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, portage and withholding
label: Consequence of disguised employment
value: Where the client intentionally avoided the employer's obligations, it is concealed employment (travail dissimulé); a client convicted of it pays the employer contributions on the sums paid
note: Tax treaties can reduce or remove the art. 182 B withholding. The wording of the subordination test is the Code du travail numérique's glossary definition.
source_title: Légifrance: Code du travail, article L8221-6 (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2023, modifié par l'ordonnance n° 2021-1189 du 15 septembre 2021, art. 35); Code du travail numérique (ministère du Travail): glossaire, Lien de subordination

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, portage and withholding
label: Portage salarial

note: Tax treaties can reduce or remove the art. 182 B withholding. The wording of the subordination test is the Code du travail numérique's glossary definition.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Corporate tax (impôt sur les sociétés) [national]
value: 25%; 15% on the first €42,500 of profit for companies with turnover up to €10,000,000; plus 3.3% social contribution above €763,000 of tax, an exceptional contribution of 20.6% or 41.2% of the tax for turnover from €1,000,000,000 (two years from 31 December 2025) and a 15% global minimum tax for groups with turnover of €750,000,000 or more. Paid by companies subject to corporate tax. CGI art. 219, 235 ter ZC and 223 VJ to 223 WZ; finance law for 2025 art. 48 and for 2026 art. 12.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social contributions on pay are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Légifrance: Code général des impôts, article 219 (version en vigueur depuis le 21 février 2026, modifié par la loi n° 2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 15); Entreprendre Service Public F23575, Impôt sur les sociétés (vérifié le 17 février 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Withholding on branch profits of foreign companies (deemed distributed profits) [national]
value: 25% on branch profits after corporate tax; none for EU and EEA companies; treaties can reduce it. Paid by foreign companies with a permanent establishment in France. CGI art. 115 quinquies, 119 bis 2 and 187. In force from 1 January 2022.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social contributions on pay are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: BOFiP BOI-RPPM-RCM-30-30-30-30-20180801: Retenue à la source applicable aux produits distribués par les sociétés étrangères exerçant une activité en France (current version)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Self-employed contributions (cotisations des travailleurs indépendants) [national]
value: health 0% to 8.5%, basic pension 17.87% up to 1 PASS, complementary pension 8.1% and 9.1%, invalidity 1.3%, family 0% to 3.1%, CSG and CRDS 9.7%; minimum contributions apply. Paid by self-employed artisans, traders and liberal professions. Code de la sécurité sociale; LFSS 2024 art. 18 and décret n° 2024-688 for the 2026 scales. In force from 1 January 2026.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social contributions on pay are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

(mis à jour le 05 octobre 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Contractor or employee: presumption and subordination test [national]
value: registered self-employed people are presumed not to be employees; a permanent legal subordination to the client makes the contract an employment contract. Paid by businesses engaging self-employed people (concealed employment otherwise). Code du travail L8221-6; portage salarial L1254-1 and L1254-2.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social contributions on pay are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Withholding on payments to non-resident contractors [national]
value: 25% on fees for services supplied or used in France (15% sports, 75% for non-cooperative states). Paid by non-residents without a permanent base in France (withheld by the payer). CGI art. 182 B.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social contributions on pay are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Simplified regimes: micro-BIC, micro-BNC, micro-social and VAT franchise [national]
value: turnover up to €203,100 (sales) or €83,600 (services), flat allowance of 71%, 50% or 34%; no VAT below €85,000 or €37,500. Paid by sole traders and freelancers who use them. CGI art. 50-0, 102 ter, 151-0 and 293 B. In force from 1 July 2026.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social contributions on pay are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employment, non-resident and property
label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
value: withholding of 0%, 12% and 20% on pay (2026 limits €17,275 and €50,112), credited against income tax at minimum rates of 20% and 30% unless the worldwide average rate is lower. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). CGI art. 4 B (residence), 182 A and 197 A. In force from 1 January 2026.
